label: Loader
description: Resolves and loads XShell resources using registered loader implementations, with optional caching and load diagnostics.

registry.description: Snapshot of resource load metadata. Entries expose resource, url, path, status, time, moduleId, and description; loaded values are not exposed.

xshell:loader:resource:fetch.description: Emitted through the application bus when a resource begins loading.

xshell:loader:resource:loaded.description: Emitted through the application bus after a resource loads successfully.

xshell:loader:resource:error.description: Emitted through the application bus when a resource loader fails.

load.description: Loads one resource, an array of resources, or an object of named resources. Returns a Promise resolving to a single loaded value, an array, or an object with the same keys, respectively. Undefined or empty-string input resolves to null. Failed resources cause a LoaderException (AggregateError). Cached values are reused according to resolver definitions; cloneable loaded values may be cloned on return.

parameters.name: resources
parameters.description: Resource identifier string, array of identifiers, or object whose values are resource identifiers.

returns.description: Promise resolving to the loaded value(s), preserving the supplied input shape.
